badgeVisualPicker.gradientNone:
Kein

Wait — I need to decide the right form. For a gradient option in a visual picker, "None" is a standalone label. The German word for it would be "Keiner", "Keine", or "Kein", depending on grammatical gender, and a neutral standalone option label usually works best as "Kein Verlauf" or simply "Keine". Since "gradient" is "Verlauf" (masculine), the label would be "Keiner", but the safest is "Kein Verlauf".

Kein Verlauf
